slides.texte_overlay:
15 life hacks I wish I knew
in my 20s

1. Make your bed in 60 seconds.
2. Lay out tomorrow's clothes.
3. Keep a spare phone charger
in your bag.

4. Cook in batches on Sundays.
5. Learn three sauces.
6. Keep a basic toolkit.

7. Remember birthdays with
reminders.
8. Reply within 24 hours.
9. Introduce people to each other.

10. Learn one thing a day.
11. Read before bed.
12. Ask "why" more often.
